name: Helios customer self-service portal
description: Sample Helios project: a fictional customer self-service portal (password reset and order status and knowledge base) replacing manual support tickets
acceptance criterion: Password-reset and order-status tickets cut by 50% within 6 months of launch

name: Project management
description: Level-of-effort element: planning and baselines plus bi-weekly steering and weekly status reporting and closure
acceptance criterion: Baselines approved by Dana Okoro and the closure report accepted

name: Discovery & design
description: Requirements and UX for the three self-service journeys

name: Requirements & user research
description: 12 customer interviews and 3 workshops with Support Operations
acceptance criterion: Requirements specification signed off by Priya Nair

name: UX design & prototype
description: Clickable prototype for password reset and order status
acceptance criterion: Prototype passes two usability rounds with pilot customers

name: Portal build
description: The portal application and its integrations

name: Identity / SSO integration
description: Single sign-on with the identity provider (vendor sandbox due in week 6)
acceptance criterion: Pilot users authenticate through SSO in staging and the security review by Marcus Webb is passed

name: Self-service UI
description: Password reset and order status screens meeting WCAG 2.2 AA
acceptance criterion: Both journeys complete end to end on desktop and mobile

name: Knowledge base
description: Searchable knowledge base with 150 migrated articles
acceptance criterion: The top 50 support questions are answered and searchable

name: Reporting & analytics
description: Ticket-deflection dashboard that evidences the 50% reduction benefit
acceptance criterion: Monthly deflection report reconciles with the ticketing system

name: System & UAT testing
description: System and regression tests plus UAT with 20 Support Operations agents
acceptance criterion: Zero open severity-1 or severity-2 defects and UAT signed off by Priya Nair

name: Hardening & launch
description: Performance and security hardening and the production cutover
acceptance criterion: Security sign-off by Marcus Webb and legal sign-off by Hana Sato - portal live to the pilot cohort of 200

name: Adoption & handover
description: Adopted portal handed to Support Operations

name: Training & communications
description: Train-the-trainer for Support Operations and customer communications
acceptance criterion: All support agents trained and launch communications sent

name: Operational handover
description: Runbooks and on-call rota handed to Support Operations
acceptance criterion: Runbooks accepted and the on-call rota live for the 4-week warranty period
